seo.title: Best Working Cafes in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Casablanca's top working cafes with reliable Wi-Fi, power outlets, and delicious food. Perfect for digital nomads and remote workers looking for productivity and comfort.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca, a vibrant hub of commerce and culture, offers an array of cafes perfectly suited for remote work, brainstorming sessions, or focused study. From chic, modern spaces to cozy, traditional spots, you'll find reliable Wi-Fi, comfortable seating, and delicious bites to fuel your productivity.

picks.name: Paul
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Paul is a timeless French bakery chain with several locations across Casablanca, making it a reliable choice for remote workers. Expect classic pastries, artisan bread, salads, and sandwiches, all served in a bright, elegant setting. The consistent quality and dependable Wi-Fi across its branches make it a go-to for many.
picks.whatToOrder: Pain au chocolat and a Cappuccino
picks.insiderTip: Visit during off-peak hours (mid-morning or late afternoon) to secure a good table with a power outlet, as it can get busy during lunch.
picks.redditQuote: "Paul is my consistent go-to in Casablanca when I need to get serious work done. The Wi-Fi is strong, the coffee is great, and their pain au chocolat never disappoints."

picks.name: Art Square
picks.whyItMadeTheList: More than just a cafe, Art Square is a cultural hub that blends art gallery, concept store, and eatery. Its spacious, artistically decorated interior provides a wonderfully inspiring backdrop for creative work. With good Wi-Fi and a diverse menu, it's perfect for longer working sessions and networking.
picks.whatToOrder: Avocado Toast and a freshly squeezed Orange Juice
picks.insiderTip: After working, take some time to browse the local art and artisanal goods on display – it's a great way to unwind and support local talent.
picks.redditQuote: "Art Square in Habous is fantastic. It's not just for coffee; the vibe is so chill and artistic, makes working feel less like work. Plus, their brunch menu is solid."

picks.name: The Exchange
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located within the Anfaplace Mall with stunning ocean views, The Exchange offers a modern and upscale environment. It's known for its excellent specialty coffee, healthy breakfast options, and a chic, minimalist design that promotes focus. The natural light and comfortable seating make it ideal for prolonged work.
picks.whatToOrder: Flat White and their Salmon Benedict
picks.insiderTip: Try to grab a table near the window for inspiring sea views, especially on a clear day. Parking is available within the mall.
picks.redditQuote: "The Exchange at Anfaplace is my secret weapon for productive mornings. The ocean view is unbeatable, and their coffee game is strong. Just try to avoid peak mall hours."

picks.name: Volta Coffee Shop
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Volta Coffee Shop is a popular spot in the trendy Gauthier district, known for its commitment to high-quality, ethically sourced coffee. The interior is contemporary and inviting, with a mix of communal tables and individual seating suitable for working. It's often frequented by freelancers and students for its vibrant atmosphere and strong Wi-Fi.
picks.whatToOrder: Pour Over coffee of the day and a homemade cookie
picks.insiderTip: They often have unique single-origin beans. Ask the barista for their current recommendations if you're a coffee enthusiast.
picks.redditQuote: "Volta has become my default for quality coffee and getting work done. The Wi-Fi is solid, and the vibe in Gauthier is just right for productivity. Their baristas really know their stuff."

picks.name: B.Loved Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: B.Loved Cafe focuses on healthy and fresh options, offering a bright and airy space that feels both chic and comfortable. It's a great choice for those seeking nutritious meals and a calm, aesthetically pleasing environment for working. Plenty of natural light and comfortable seating contribute to a productive atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Acai Bowl and a Matcha Latte
picks.insiderTip: Their brunch menu is incredibly popular on weekends, so for a focused work session, aim for a weekday morning.
picks.redditQuote: "B.Loved is a gem in Gauthier. I love going there for healthy food and to get some writing done. It feels very clean and organized, perfect for clearing your head."

picks.name: Mood's Coffee
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mood's Coffee offers a stylish and modern setting with cozy seating arrangements, making it a favorite among young professionals and students. The menu features a variety of coffee drinks, teas, and American-style desserts like cheesecakes and brownies. Its relaxed ambiance and good Wi-Fi are conducive to both collaborative and individual work.
picks.whatToOrder: Caramel Macchiato and a slice of New York Cheesecake
picks.insiderTip: They have several comfortable armchairs and sofas, which are perfect for settling in with your laptop for a few hours.
picks.redditQuote: "Mood's Coffee in Racine is surprisingly good for getting work done. It's got that comfortable, 'third place' vibe, and their Wi-Fi connection is usually pretty reliable."

picks.name: Maestro Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Maestro Cafe provides a more classic cafe experience with a spacious interior and comfortable seating, ideal for longer working periods. It offers a diverse menu, from traditional Moroccan breakfast items to international lunch options. The ambiance is generally calm, making it easy to concentrate.
picks.whatToOrder: Moroccan Mint Tea and a selection of pastries
picks.insiderTip: This cafe is great for meeting clients or colleagues due to its more formal yet relaxed setting. Ample space ensures privacy.
picks.redditQuote: "I often work from Maestro Cafe when I'm in Anfa. It's got a classic feel, never too loud, and the staff are used to people setting up their laptops for hours."

picks.name: Nid D'hirondelle
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nid D'hirondelle (Swallow's Nest) is a charming local patisserie that also offers a comfortable space for working. While primarily a bakery, their small seating area is quiet and inviting, often with softer background music. It's perfect for a quick, focused work session accompanied by delicious pastries and coffee.
picks.whatToOrder: Croissant Amandes and a Café Noir
picks.insiderTip: It's best for a shorter work stint or when you need a quiet place to read and respond to emails. The Wi-Fi is usually decent for lighter tasks.
picks.redditQuote: "If you need a quiet corner with amazing pastries to power through some emails, Nid D'hirondelle is surprisingly good. Don't expect a full office setup, but it's charming."

picks.name: L'Atelier des Gâteaux
picks.whyItMadeTheList: L'Atelier des Gâteaux offers an upscale bakery experience with a refined atmosphere. While it's known for its exquisite cakes and desserts, the interior provides a comfortable and relatively quiet space for working. It’s ideal for those who appreciate a more luxurious setting while tackling their tasks, with reliable Wi-Fi and attentive service.
picks.whatToOrder: Lemon Meringue Tart and a Latte
picks.insiderTip: The presentation of their desserts is an art form. Treat yourself to a visually stunning and delicious break from your work.
picks.redditQuote: "I love L'Atelier des Gâteaux for focused work. It's usually quiet enough, and let's be honest, having those beautiful pastries nearby is a major motivator!"

picks.name: Cosy Corner
picks.whyItMadeTheList: True to its name, Cosy Corner offers a relaxed and comfortable ambiance, especially appealing given its location near Ain Diab beach. While it can get lively, there are often quieter corners suitable for working. The extensive menu, including brunch and seafood options, means you can stay fueled throughout the day.
picks.whatToOrder: Pancakes with fresh fruit and a Mint Tea
picks.insiderTip: Go early in the morning for the calmest atmosphere and to snag a spot with good natural light. It's a great option if you want to mix work with a sea breeze.
picks.redditQuote: "Cosy Corner by Ain Diab beach is surprisingly good for a 'work-cation' day. Good food, decent wifi, and the sound of the ocean is a nice change from a stuffy office."

picks.name: Starbucks
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Starbucks, with its numerous locations across Casablanca, offers a familiar and consistently reliable environment for working. While not unique, you can always count on good Wi-Fi, plenty of power outlets, and a standardized menu. It's a safe bet for a productive session when you need an international standard of comfort and service.
picks.whatToOrder: Grande Americano and a Butter Croissant
picks.insiderTip: The Starbucks at Twin Center offers excellent views of the city, which can be inspiring. It's usually quite spacious as well.
picks.redditQuote: "Yeah, it's Starbucks, but honestly, when you just need guaranteed Wi-Fi and power, the one at Twin Center in Casablanca is a lifesaver. Plus, decent views."

picks.name: La Croisière
picks.whyItMadeTheList: La Croisière is a more local and unpretentious cafe, offering excellent value and a genuine Casablanca experience. While it might not have the sleekest design, it's a solid choice for budget-conscious workers. It's frequented by locals, has decent Wi-Fi for basic tasks, and serves traditional Moroccan coffee and pastries.
picks.whatToOrder: Traditional Moroccan Coffee (Café Noir) and Msmen
picks.insiderTip: This is a great spot to practice your Darija (Moroccan Arabic) as staff and patrons are often friendly and local. Perfect for a quick, authentic work break.
picks.redditQuote: "For a truly local, no-frills work session, La Croisière in Bourgogne is surprisingly effective. Cheap coffee, good msmen, and you feel like part of the neighborhood, not just a tourist."

faq.question: What should I look for in a working cafe in Casablanca?
faq.answer: When choosing a working cafe, prioritize reliable and fast Wi-Fi, availability of power outlets, and comfortable seating. Also consider the noise level – some cafes are better suited for focused work, while others are great for casual meetings. Finally, good quality coffee and snacks are key to staying productive.

faq.question: Is Wi-Fi generally reliable in Casablanca's cafes?
faq.answer: Generally, most modern and popular cafes in Casablanca offer reliable Wi-Fi, especially those catering to a younger, professional crowd. However, speeds can vary. It's always a good idea to test the connection shortly after arriving, or ask a staff member if you're unsure.

faq.question: Are there any cafes that cater specifically to digital nomads?
faq.answer: While there aren't many cafes exclusively for digital nomads, several venues like Art Square, The Exchange, and Volta Coffee Shop are highly popular with the remote working community due to their excellent facilities, inspiring atmospheres, and strong Wi-Fi. Many also offer diverse menus to support longer stays.

faq.question: What are typical prices for coffee and light meals in these cafes?
faq.answer: Prices for a coffee and a pastry typically range from MAD 30-70 ($3-7 USD). For a light lunch, such as a sandwich or salad with a drink, expect to pay between MAD 70-150 ($7-15 USD). Upscale cafes or those with specialty items may be slightly higher, but good value options are widely available.

faq.question: Do I need to make reservations to work at these cafes?
faq.answer: Reservations are generally not required for working at cafes in Casablanca. However, during peak hours (lunchtime, early evenings, and weekends), popular spots can get busy. Arriving during off-peak times (mid-morning or mid-afternoon on weekdays) will make it easier to secure a good spot with access to power outlets.

faq.question: Are these cafes suitable for client meetings?
faq.answer: Yes, many of the listed cafes are excellent for client meetings, especially Maestro Cafe, Paul, and The Exchange, which offer a more professional yet comfortable ambiance. Look for venues with ample space and a slightly quieter atmosphere to ensure productive discussions.

methodology: Our selection of Casablanca's best working cafes is based on extensive local research, verified user reviews, and expert insights focusing on Wi-Fi reliability, availability of power outlets, comfort, ambiance, and quality of food and beverages. We prioritized venues offering a conducive environment for productivity, whether for a quick check-in or an all-day work session.
